notes.title: Input & movement adjustments
notes.content:
- Less sliding when you stop sliding so that sliding is more intentional. sliding.

- I've adjusted acceleration and deceleration so that turning around is faster, while still retaining some of that Mario HEFT.

- Adjusted controller input so that the joystick doesn't kill momentum when backing off, making it identical to keyboard input, but with the option to move more slowly.

- Fixed some bugs. I kinda forgot to take notes. Resolution stuff... and others.

The game still has bugs and issues but I'm workin' on 'em! Just wanted to push this build because I actually really like the input updates, thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Fixed "Sink or Swim" and other floaty stages
notes.content: Fixed "Sink or Swim" and other floaty stages.

notes.title: Ghost Fix
notes.content: If ghosts are broken on stages you had already cleared before this update, hit [b]Ctrl+Shift+T[/b] on the overworld to reset best-times for all stages, this will fix the ghosts without starting a totally new file.

notes.title: Big big mistake. I'm so sorry. Also now race your own ghost in each stage.
notes.content:
Hey all. So sorry. The build you've been playing was very old (like 6 months!!).

I am facepalming so hard right now.

If you ran into a bunch of weird bugs that ruined the experience, please give it another go. 

Also, new version has ghosts of your fastest time on each stage, but you might have to start fresh to get ghosts and best-times to work correctly (Sorry!).

Thank you.

notes.title: First playtest update
notes.content:
Many small changes.
Most importantly, some stages were not included, and would crash the game, but now they are included properly!
Some default controls were changed for WASD mode.
Some bug fixes.
Some general polish.

This update did not take playtester feedback into account, that will be the next one, so please leave feedback on steam or on the Discord, 
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Hello Playtesters!
notes.content:
Thank you for playtesting the game! I'm excited to hear your feedback.

Please leave your feedback here at the Steam community page or [url=https://discord.gg/hVfHRxu]at the game's Discord community, here.[/url]

Or if you want to email me directly: blakefix@gmail.com


Important notes:

This is a limited-access playtest, so the game may not be feature-complete or completely polished. Please be patient and report any problems you encounter.
Your feedback will be used to improve the game before its official release.
I appreciate your participation and can't wait to hear your thoughts!

Thank you!! 

- Blake 😎👍

(P.S. If you're waiting to gain access to the playtest, I'm going to let more people in, but I'd like to gather feedback from the initial group first, so just hold tight, thank you!)
